evidence.evidence_text: In this work, we systematically evaluate four state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) — Claude, GPT, Mistral, and Qwen — for dehumanization detection.Our results show that only one model—Claude—achieves strong performance (over 80% F_1) under an optimized configuration, while others, despite their capabilities, perform only moderately.
